title: Settings → Email: edit sender then delete the domain
journey: Continue from the previous test (or create a fresh e2e-test domain row)
On the Sending domains row, click Edit sender
In the dialog, change the From name to 'E2E Renamed Sender' and the Local-part to 'billing'
Confirm the preview reads: 'Will send as: E2E Renamed Sender <billing@<domain>>'
Click Save and wait for the toast 'Sender settings saved.'
Confirm the row now shows 'E2E Renamed Sender' and 'billing@<domain>'
Click Delete on the same row
In the Delete confirmation dialog, click Delete to confirm
Wait for the toast 'Sending domain removed.'
Confirm the row is gone (the Sending domains card returns to empty state or no longer contains the e2e-test domain)
